title: Senior Manager, Corporate Accounting & Finance Transformation
description: Strength in Trust  OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.   The Challenge We are seeking a highly motivated and Senior Manager of Corporate Accounting to help drive the next phase of our accounting organization’s evolution. This role sits at the intersection of accounting, controls, and business transformation. The ideal candidate combines deep accounting expertise with operational leadership capabilities and a passion for process improvement. This individual will help establish a scalable controls environment, lead reporting initiatives, and assist in developing the company's AI governance and controls framework. Your Mission Internal Controls & Risk Management Design, implement, and continuously improve a scalable internal controls framework across accounting and finance processes. Partner with process owners to identify control gaps, evaluate risks, and implement sustainable remediation plans. Support SOX readiness, compliance programs, and internal audit activities. Develop control documentation, narratives, risk assessments, and testing methodologies. Establish governance processes around emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions. Monitor evolving accounting standards and assess organizational impact. Systems Implementation & Process Improvement Support finance transformation initiatives, including ERP, reporting, consolidation, and workflow automation projects. Serve as a key accounting stakeholder during system implementations and enhancements. Evaluate existing processes and recommend automation opportunities. Develop scalable accounting workflows that improve efficiency while maintaining control integrity. Assist in roadmap planning for finance technology investments. Data Integrity & Governance Partner with Finance Systems, Business Systems, and Data teams to improve master data quality and governance. Support initiatives focused on financial data accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Develop monitoring processes and controls around critical financial datasets. Assist in root-cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues impacting financial reporting. AI Governance & Controls Framework Assist in establishing an AI Controls Center of Excellence within the finance organization. Develop policies, standards, and governance frameworks for AI-enabled accounting and finance processes. Design controls around AI-generated outputs, model monitoring, data integrity, and regulatory compliance. Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, and Business Systems to develop an enterprise AI control environment. Evaluate opportunities to responsibly leverage AI to improve accounting operations and decision-making. You Are/Have Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. CPA required. 8+ years of progressive accounting, audit, financial reporting, or finance transformation experience. Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, technical accounting, and financial reporting requirements. Experience designing and implementing internal controls. Proven project management and cross-functional leadership skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Extra Awesome Big 4 public accounting experience. Experience supporting M&A integrations and carve-outs. Experience with system implementations and finance transformation initiatives. Knowledge of SOX 404, COSO, and internal audit methodologies. Experience with Workday, NetSuite, SAP, or other enterprise financial systems. Exposure to AI governance, automation tools, or data governance programs. We're looking for a Governance, Risk and Compliance Director to lead this team through its next phase of growth. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you. We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. Our Values If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. Who You Are You’re a seasoned compliance leader who knows that strong regulatory functions depend on clear ownership, capable teams, disciplined execution, and sound judgment. You bring meaningful experience leading regulatory compliance operations in a highly regulated environment. You can translate complex requirements into practical processes, challenge and support subject matter experts, and build the management systems needed to execute regulatory obligations consistently. You are equally comfortable developing teams, engaging with regulators and external partners, partnering with Legal and business leaders, and communicating risks and priorities to senior leadership. You enjoy strengthening functions that are evolving, creating clarity where processes or ownership are fragmented, and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Develop team members and build the capabilities, judgment, and accountability needed for consistent regulatory execution. title: Lead Compliance Risk Manager, Product Compliance - AI
description: About the role: As Mercury continues its rapid growth trajectory, navigating an increasingly complex regulatory, partner, and product landscape is critical. Compliance is not only a requirement, but a competitive advantage that enables Mercury to move faster, build trust, and launch innovative products responsibly.  Nowhere is that more true than in AI. We believe we have a path to lead the US banking* industry into the AI era, and that how we choose to build and deploy AI will define our success over the next three years.  We are building first-party agentic products, headless and agent-accessible banking through our API and MCP, and the internal platforms that let us build with AI at speed. Core to all of it is great governance—these systems must run on one trusted system of access, logging, and data controls that meets the requirements of our banking ambitions. We are seeking a Lead Compliance Risk Manager to serve as the compliance advisor for Mercury's AI products. This is a new, high-visibility role and the first dedicated compliance advisory seat covering AI at Mercury. You will be the leading authority on AI product compliance risk for the Compliance Team—shaping how we build, how we govern, and how we explain ourselves to our partners and regulators. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Data, Legal, and Operations to ensure Mercury's AI products are compliant-by-design from concept through launch and scale. You will also help define the AI governance framework itself: the standards, controls, escalation paths, and documentation that allow a bank-partnered fintech to deploy agentic capabilities responsibly and at pace. How this role fits alongside our other AI roles : this is a product compliance advisory role. Our Data & AI Governance team owns enterprise governance frameworks, responsible-AI standards, AI use case intake and inventory, and risk classification; Model Risk Management owns model inventory, tiering, and validation. You will be a close partner to and a major consumer of both—running our AI products through their processes, applying their standards to real product decisions, and bringing them the product-level detail they need to see. You will also help extend our existing product compliance playbooks to cover AI features, in partnership with your manager and the rest of the Product Compliance team. Your mandate is the products, not the program.  In this role, you will: Serve as the subject matter expert and primary compliance advisor for Mercury's AI and agentic products, including Command, our API, and agentic access methods such as MCP and CLI. Work closely with cross-functional risk and product teams to bring Mercury's AI products to market in a way that meets all relevant financial partner, regulatory compliance obligations, and our AI governance standards. Ensure all processes and products under your area of responsibility comply with applicable rules and regulations. Stay up to date with changes to applicable regulations, supervisory guidance, and emerging AI-specific law, and implement necessary updates to impacted products to maintain compliance. Support expansion for new product launches by scoping, defining, and communicating product and compliance requirements. Work cross-functionally to drive remediation efforts for products within your defined scope. Support the compliance function in defining and achieving departmental initiatives, maintaining relevant policies and procedures, developing documentation solutions, and liaising with auditors. Mentor and provide strategic guidance to compliance colleagues as AI capabilities spread across every product domain, and contribute to building a strong culture of compliance across Mercury. Work closely with our Risk team, which owns AI governance, as Compliance’s AI product expert to contribute product-level guidance to ongoing AI governance updates. Core responsibilities: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Data, Operations, and Legal to bring Mercury's AI products to market in a manner that meets all relevant regulatory, financial partner, and network obligations. Advise product and engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle—discovery, design, evaluation, launch, and iteration—to ensure AI products are compliant-by-design rather than reviewed after the fact. Identify, assess, and document compliance risks specific to AI and agentic systems—including inaccurate or fabricated output, unauthorized or over-scoped agent action, inadequate consent and disclosure, unexplainable decisioning, disparate impact, data leakage across customers or organizations, prompt injection and third-party agent risk, and insufficient audit trail—and work cross-functionally to design pragmatic mitigation strategies. Define the compliance requirements for the platforms AI is built on, in partnership with the teams that own them: the LLM gateway all internal traffic routes through, the internal app

title: Principal, Employment Counsel
description: At Skillsoft , we believe skills fuel growth. Our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress. Employment Counsel Skillsoft is seeking an experienced Principal Employment Counsel to join our team! In this fast-paced exciting role, the Employment Counsel will work closely with the People Team and business leaders to provide timely, solutions-focused advice on a broad range of employment and employee relations matters, contributing to the overall success and growth of the company. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted legal partner who can identify risk, exercise sound judgment, and develop practical solutions that support Skillsoft’s business objectives and values. This role offers the opportunity to advise a global organization on complex and evolving employment issues, manage international disputes and investigations, develop scalable employment practices, and collaborate across functions and regions. This role requires a proactive and business-oriented mindset, strong analytical skills, and excellent communication and interpersonal expertise. RESPONSIBILITIES Employment Advice and Counsel: Provide accurate and timely legal advice and counsel to internal clients on a wide range of employment corporate matters, including recruiting, hiring, onboarding and performance management. Advise on sensitive and complex employee relations matters, balancing legal risk, employee experience, business objectives, and operational realities. Translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for People Team professionals, managers, and business leaders. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of Skillsoft’s workforce, business priorities, and operating model. Contract Review and Negotiation: Draft, review, and update employment-related documents, including, offer letters and employment agreements; restrictive covenant, confidentiality, and intellectual property agreements, separation agreements and releases; commission, bonus, and incentive plan documents; Performance management and disciplinary documentation; Investigation plans, interview outlines, findings, and remediation documents; employee policies, handbooks, notices, acknowledgments, and consent forms; workforce transition materials. Review employment communications for legal risk, clarity, consistency, and alignment with company practices. Develop practical templates, playbooks, checklists, and self-service resources for common employment matters. Support periodic reviews of employment policies and practices to identify compliance gaps and opportunities for simplification or standardization. Global Employment Compliance Provide employment law counseling across the jurisdictions in which Skillsoft operates, coordinating with local counsel and regional stakeholders as appropriate. Monitor developments in global labor and employment laws and advise on changes needed to Skillsoft policies, practices, agreements, and processes. Develop and maintain tools that help Skillsoft identify, prioritize, and manage employment-related legal and compliance risk, including support regarding employee training and compliance. Investigations and Employee Relations Advise on and conduct workplace investigations involving allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation, misconduct, conflicts of interest, policy violations, and other sensitive employee matters. Work with the People Team to define an appropriate investigation plan, privilege structure, interim measures, documentation approach, findings, remediation, and follow-up. Provide clear and balanced recommendations regarding corrective action, remediation, process improvements, and retaliation monitoring. Dispute Management Manage employment litigation, administrative charges, labor proceedings, pre-litigation disputes, demand letters, and settlement negotiations in the United States and internationally. Develop case strategy in partnership with internal stakeholders and external counsel, including review of factual records, assessment of exposure, preservation and discovery strategy, and evaluation of settlement options. Engage and supervise counsel when as needed. GENERAL COMPLIANCE Support Skillsoft’s enterprise compliance program which includes such areas as ERM, ESG, and other regulatory compliance. Strengthen compliance program infrastructure by maintaining policies, controls, and documentation that feed ERM and Audit Committee oversight, and partner with Legal Operations to reduce key-person dependency across compliance readiness. REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 8+ years of professional experience as a corporate attorney, preferably in a similar internal role or with a reputable law firm with a Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and active membership in the bar association. Strong experience and knowledge of United States employment law, with demonstrated ability to advise on global or multi-jurisdictional employment and other regulatory matters, and manage local counsel. Experience advising on workplace investigations, employee relations matters, employment disputes, administrative proceedings, and employment litigation. Strong drafting and review experience involving employment agreements, separation documents, policies, handbooks, investigation materials, and other employment-related documents. Experience advising on and supporting corporate compliance programs, including policy governance, risk assessments, compliance training, internal controls, investigations, and regulatory compliance initiatives. Familiarity with enterprise risk management (ERM), ESG-related compliance considerations, audit and compliance governance processes, and partnering with cross-functional teams to develop scalable compliance frameworks and controls. Demonstrated ability to identify emerging legal and regulatory risks, develop practical compliance solutions, and implement sustainable processes that support business objectives while promoting a culture of integrity and accountability. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to provide practical advice that aligns legal risk management with business objectives. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex employment law concepts clearly and effectively to non-legal stakeholders. Skilled at working collaboratively with the People Team and other cross-functional stakeholders, while also working independently, prioritizing tasks, and managing multiple matters simultaneously. Ability to be agile and take initiative, recognizing opportunities and initiating actions to develop practical, scalable, and productive ways to support the business. Demonstrated emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, with the ability to navigate sensitive and high-stakes issues professionally while maintaining perspective, humility, and a healthy sense of humor. Thrives in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and brings a positive, pragmatic mindset, taking the work seriously and delivering at a high level without taking themselves too seriously. Target base salary range for this job requisition is anticipated to be approximately $175,000 - $190,000 annualized. We also offer Enterprise benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, and paid time off. The company may modify salaries, salary ranges and/or Pay Plans from time to time as it deems necessary. Skillsoft uses AI-enabled tools to screen applications. Recruitment and hiring decisions are made by Skillsoft personnel and are not based solely on automated processing. MORE ABOUT SKILLSOFT: Skillsoft (NYSE: SKIL) is a global leader in AI-native skills management for the human + AI era. By unifying learning, real-time skills intelligence, and workforce insights, Skillsoft helps enterprises build their Skillforce™ — humans and AI working together to drive measurable business outcomes. Through personalized, interactive learning across leadership, technology, and compliance, Skillsoft enables organizations to close critical skill gaps and accelerate transformation. Skillsoft is trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 1000, and supports a global community of more than 105 million learners. Learn more at skillsoft.com . Thank you for taking the time to learn more about us. If this opportunity intrigues you, we would love for you to apply! NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES: We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Skillsoft does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Skillsoft employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Skillsoft Employment Agency Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means. Skillsoft is an equal opportunity employer.
